gen-almendra-display-gf-victor-mono: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display drapes the headline in open, generous curves. And Victor Mono lines up beneath it as a monospace, loose-spaced and structured, so a modest bump in its size is a fair suggestion.
gen-almendra-display-gf-viga: Viga reads like a plain sans, with strokes free of hairlines and shadows and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Almendra Display brings the literary flourish; Viga does the quiet work.
gen-almendra-display-gf-voces: Ornate, bookish, a little theatrical up top. Voces follows with tall lowercase and a modest stem-to-hairline difference, so paragraphs move along smoothly beneath Almendra Display.
gen-almendra-display-gf-winky-rough: Almendra Display stands out for letters that never pinch shut, giving its ornate, literary tone a generous openness. Winky Rough, a plain sans, sits close to cap height below.
gen-almendra-display-gf-winky-sans: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters with a pronounced x-height and curves that stay open. Winky Sans steps in as the plain sans, its capitals barely taller than lowercase, keeping the page modern and uncluttered.
gen-almendra-display-gf-yantramanav: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display opens its curves wide and lifts its lowercase high on the line. Yantramanav, a modern sans with close-set letters, takes over below.
gen-almendra-display-plus-jakarta-sans: Almendra Display carries an ornate, literary voice, its curves never pinching shut and its lowercase standing tall. Plus Jakarta Sans follows with round-pen monoline letters, modern and precise.
gen-almendra-display-space-grotesk: Almendra Display leads with ornate, literary curves that stay open and a pronounced x-height. But Space Grotesk, a sans with constant-width ribbon strokes and breathing counters, keeps the text geometric and level.
gen-archivo-black-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono lines its letters up like nails on a ruler, structured and precise with no thick-and-thin contrast. But Archivo Black is the authoritative, urban one, its diagonals as hefty as its stems.
gen-archivo-black-gf-geist-mono: Archivo Black is authoritative and urban, with generous room around each letter. Geist Mono, a monospace with technical, code-style letters and high lowercase, can go a touch larger than you'd expect since its side gaps are so big.
